text:
Eric Pohlkamp is three games into his NHL career and already has a moment to keep: his first NHL point came Saturday in Dallas. The fifth-round pick from Baxter, Minnesota, made his debut in Los Angeles last week, and San Jose Hockey Now's preview headline this weekend opened with praise for him.

His path is worth knowing. He went from Bemidji State to the University of Denver, and last season he scored 18 goals in 43 games there, a remarkable number for a college defenseman. That shot is the reason the Sharks called him up.

Three games tell us almost nothing, and we'd say so even if they were great. He's playing about 16 minutes a night, San Jose has been outchanced with him on the ice (38% of the expected goals), and our range for a full season is enormous, 10 to 34 points, which is the honest way of saying we don't know yet. On a rebuilding team with injuries, he'll get the chance to show us. The thing to watch is whether that college shot finds its way through NHL traffic.
headline: Pohlkamp's first steps
